card.name: Digits after 9 in model numbers and purity
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point right after a leading 9 inside an instrument model number (Hitachi 917, Vitros 950, radeon 9600) or a high purity figure (99.999%, 99.9+ % HPLC grade).

modes.label: Analyzer model numbers
modes.description: Digits inside lab instrument or hardware model numbers that start with 9 or 4.

modes.label: Purity percentages
modes.description: The repeated 9s or decimal point in near-100% purity or grade values for reagents and gases.

card.writes: It suppresses 'optimal' and 'optimization' words, so it adds no clear positive effect beyond avoiding those.
card.plain: It fires on the digits inside equipment model numbers and very high purity percentages like 99.999%.
